tone.target: chorus-soaked 80s arena crunch with bright sustain
tone.profile: chorus-soaked 80s arena crunch with bright sustain
tone.summary: A bright, chorused signal chain built around a UK-style crunch amp (UK 45/50) for punchy rhythm chords and sustained lead lines, complemented by Chorus and Digital Delay.
